title: ImageButtonElementProps
description: The props of a custom image button: an image of the tale's project, by its storage key, never a URL, that opens its destination. Its alt text is the element's `a11y.label`, the link's accessible name; publishing needs it (the decorative mark does not apply to a link) and a destination.

mediaKey.description: The storage key of an image (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP) of the tale's project, as the server made it.

href.description: The destination: an absolute http or https URL of at most 2,048 characters, without credentials, spaces or control characters.

newTab.description: Opens the destination in a new tab, with `noopener`; the same tab when left out.

radius.description: The corner radius as a fraction of the canvas height; 0 when left out.
